ss-comm-mechanics-explicit-service-agree.name: Explicit service agreement
ss-comm-mechanics-explicit-service-agree.designIntent: A reviewed transaction between independent parties
prerequisites: The particular service adapter and its fixed scope must be separately implemented and approved.
Both parties have explicitly accepted the actual price, schedule, input ownership, delivery standard, and cancellation terms.
The payer has authority over the selected personal or shared wallet; availability and provider consent are current.

effects.target: A reviewed transaction between independent parties
effects.trigger: After explicit selection and successful validation of all prerequisites.
effects.change: Record only the specifically accepted service, payer, provider, inputs, outputs, permissions, and settlement receipt. Apply its already approved typed work rule, never parse the service prose as an effect.
exclusions: No automatic service inventory, unlimited market restock, research bypass, personal mastery, or recruited worker.

costs.workOwner: The actual willing provider; use her primary assignment only if she is a participating worker under an implemented work rule. Never create an invisible resident worker.

ss-comm-mechanics-explicit-service-agree.stackingRule: No stacking with itself or a second reward for the same delivery. A service does not add research, copying, harvesting, or craft bonuses.
ss-comm-mechanics-explicit-service-agree.cancellationRule: Before work starts, release reserved funds and return untouched property to its actual owner. After work starts, reconcile only recorded accepted work and consumed inputs under the disclosed agreement. No cancellation penalty can be invented after acceptance.
ss-comm-mechanics-explicit-service-agree.repeatUseRule: A receipt settles once. A new request needs a new accepted order, actual provider availability, and fresh inputs; refreshing a service listing creates neither stock nor revenue.
ss-comm-mechanics-explicit-service-agree.failureOrRecovery: A failed precondition changes nothing. Interrupted work remains resumable or cancellable; persist ownership, costs, stage, and receipt atomically.
ss-comm-mechanics-explicit-service-agree.balanceRationale: An optional bounded affordance, not a new income or work multiplier. Unset costs require design review rather than being interpreted as zero.
testScenarios: Reject a missing prerequisite without spending inputs or moving the phase.
Submit the same operation twice; apply its result and settlement only once.
Cancel at each stage and reconcile actual input ownership without duplicate refunds.
Save, reload, and resume; preserve selected target, progress, and completed receipts.
implementationNeeds: Typed adapters for each enabled service and review of all unresolved prices, phases, and quantities.
Separate order parties, wallet authority, reserved goods, accepted terms, stage, and idempotent settlement.
Refusal, cancellation, partial-work reconciliation, property return, and save persistence.

ss-post-mechanics-bounded-commission-set.name: Bounded commission settlement
ss-post-mechanics-bounded-commission-set.designIntent: Accepted commission ownership and one-time settlement
prerequisites: The commissioned work is supported by a separately implemented typed rule and all personal knowledge, preparation, room, ownership, and assignment requirements hold.
Client and worker explicitly accept a fixed work scope, maximum reward, actual payer funds, material ownership, delivery conditions, and cancellation terms.
Any baseline automatic income or output has been accounted for in the agreement; do not pay twice for the same work.

effects.target: Accepted commission ownership and one-time settlement
effects.trigger: After explicit selection and successful validation of all prerequisites.
effects.change: After the actual requested work and agreed delivery are verified, settle only the specifically approved bounded payment or exchange against its recorded payer, recipient, and output instance. A letter, duplicated request, or repeat inspection cannot create a second reward.
exclusions: No extra worker, personal mastery, prepared slot, intimacy, or Resonance is granted.

costs.workOwner: The actual willing maker or caster uses her own single primary assignment; a client or correspondent does not become an extra worker.

ss-post-mechanics-bounded-commission-set.stackingRule: Commission settlement never multiplies baseline output or copying income. Distinguish baseline production from an explicitly funded later sale or transfer; all receipts link to the same output provenance.
ss-post-mechanics-bounded-commission-set.cancellationRule: Before start, release reservations to their actual owners. During work, retain the recorded partial state and reconcile only agreed consumed inputs and accepted work. ss-post-mechanics-bounded-commission-set.repeatUseRule: One settlement per accepted commission ID and output instance. A new commission requires a genuinely new accepted scope, funded reward, available worker, and new eligible work; no unlimited letter farm.
